text: The Project Manager will take notes and place the minutes in the shared folder (item 0).
A combined energy source using battery with kinetic back-up, and battery charging when moved, was adopted (item 1).
Adopt the primary audience of people below 40 with a secondary audience of people above 40; also approve a double-curved rubber case with a removable cover (items 2, 3).

Removable covers will be provided in multiple colors; offer two remote models (basic and deluxe); provide an expert view and a simple view of the interface; include simple parental controls accessible via a menu; treat Games and voice recognition as optional features; Real Reaction branding to be presented as a single brand with a strong identity; the interface should feature one large touchscreen with primary buttons and a shallow menu (items 4,5,6,7,8,9,10).
UI reports windows problems during the session, five-minute time pressure, and budget/cost constraints for chips and LCD components (items 11,12,13).
